scripts.dev:infra: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml -f compose.playback.yaml --profile playback up postgres valkey playback-valkey
scripts.docker:web:fast: docker compose -f compose.yaml build web && docker compose -f compose.yaml up -d --no-deps --no-build web
scripts.docker:dev:playback: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml -f compose.playback.yaml --profile playback up --watch --build
scripts.backup:run: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.production.yaml --profile backup run --rm backup
scripts.backup:check: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.production.yaml --profile backup run --rm --entrypoint consumit-backup-check backup
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
